name: Stuffed Portabella Mushrooms
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 4 oz mozzarella cheese (fresh or regular), diced or grated
10 Saltine crackers, crushed or ½ cup bread crumbs

steps: Generously sprinkle vinegar over the mushrooms, and top with garlic. Leave for 30 minutes or so.
Combine the egg, cheeses, crackers and seasonings in a bowl. Mix well. Spoon the mixture onto the mushrooms.
